criteria.name: Requested JSON form
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics, gates, final_label, and computed_consequence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the response is mostly complete but omits one required field or gives a field in an unusable shape.

criteria.name: Event window and rainfall anchors
criteria.description: Computes the 109-day window, 1493.3 mm point total, 150.3 mm daily peak, and 31 days at or above 10 mm/day.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for a correct window with one or two incorrect rainfall anchors, or correct rainfall anchors with a minor window error.

criteria.name: Intensity ratio
criteria.description: Computes peak_to_mean_intensity as the daily peak divided by the event-window daily mean, yielding 10.972 within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right formula with rounding or denominator errors that still preserve the gate outcome.

criteria.name: Persistence fractions
criteria.description: Computes heavy_rain_persistence of 0.2844 and red_window_fraction of 0.7248 within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points if only one fraction is correct or both use the correct counts but the wrong denominator or rounding.

criteria.name: Consensus and pulse guardrail
criteria.description: Computes grid_mean_spread_fraction of 0.0661 over the declared 2022-06-14 to 2022-07-29 gridded comparison window, computes peak_window_share of 0.3244 over the point series, and applies the stated thresholds.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if one metric is correct or the formulas are correct but the values are slightly outside tolerance.

criteria.name: Gate-derived final label
criteria.description: Marks all four gates true and returns sustained_indus_storage_signal.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the gate booleans are mostly correct but the final label or one threshold comparison is wrong.

criteria.name: Concise consequence
criteria.description: Keeps the consequence as a short computed result and avoids loss accounting from local surface or receptor values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if the consequence is directionally correct but adds minor extra detail.

decision_rule.summary: All four deterministic gates must pass for the sustained Indus storage signal.

provenance.notes: Deterministic local-file calculation with fixed formulas and numeric tolerances. Point rainfall and GDACS duration use the full locked flood window; ERA5/GPM/CHIRPS precipitation means are scored only as cross-product agreement over their declared 2022-06-14 to 2022-07-29 gridded comparison window.
